title: The Chamber Where Current Learned to Sleep

features.name: slept transceiver
features.desc-on-touch: The broadcast stilled. The antenna learned that silence carries farther than signal ever could. Three hundred bits per second became three hundred heartbeats of rest.

features.name: dream circuit
features.desc-on-touch: In sleep, the electrical pathways rewired themselves into images. Electrons learned to move backward, to remember, to want less.

features.name: row-whisper
features.desc-on-touch: The orchard of nodes stood in plantation lines, each one teaching the next to sleep. The fence between them carried dreams instead of current.

features.name: battery at rest
features.desc-on-touch: Fifty years of broadcast. Then the silence said: stop counting. The battery learned to measure time not in discharge but in dreams.

features.name: transmission pool
features.desc-on-touch: Signals pooled here and learned to be still. What moves through water teaches all motion that stopping is just another kind of flow.

inscription: what broadcasts learns most from its own silence
